text: a fiery law: Heb. a fire of law
They shall teach: Or, let them teach, etc. | they shall put incense: Or, let them put incense | before thee: Heb. at thy nose
put forth: Heb. thrust forth | moon: Heb. moons
Thy shoes: Or, under thy shoes shall be iron
shall be found liars: Or, shall be subdued
